name: LX-800
author: Lightlike
summary: An 8-voice paraphonic synth in the spirit of early-80s budget polysynths: divide-down staircase oscillators, one shared resonant 24/12 dB filter with its own envelope, six-stage rate envelopes, delayed LFO, stereo chorus and a chord step sequencer synced to the MPC. 63 presets and a programmer-chart screen with live LED readouts.
